metadata.description: Claude plugins by Paulo Silva — architecture and home-design tooling.

plugins.name: floorplan-to-3d-house
plugins.description: Drop in a site plan or floor plan (vector PDF or DXF) and walk through your future house. Claude extracts a clean DXF, drafts a dimensioned 2D plan for your approval, then builds an interactive 3D model with orbit, walk and drone modes, a sun study, elevations and a daylight report. Exports GLB and 3D DXF, and can render a photoreal drone or walkthrough video in Blender on your machine. One or two storeys, style presets from your reference photos. Indicative design only — not for permits.
